Recorded deviation from the plan: interface spec section 8 and microarchitecture section 5 call for a SymbiYosys proof (apb_gpio.sby and apb_gpio_n32.sby). This task's expected outputs are only rtl_source and testbench, and formal.run accepts exactly one formal_spec file. I submitted no formal_spec, so the formal requirements do not apply to this submission. The formal proof remains open work for a follow-up task. The tech lead should decide whether it belongs to this task.

No `timescale is used in either file, which avoids a TIMESCALEMOD mismatch under Verilator. The RTL sets `default_nettype none and restores it to wire at the end of the file. The testbench avoids string-literal widths, so the build should not trip Verilator's default-fatal WIDTH warnings.
